articles.title: Why is market rising today? Sensex rallies over 650 pts, Nifty nears 24K. Key factors driving D-St rebound
articles.content: Indian stock markets experienced a significant upswing on Wednesday, with both the Sensex and Nifty registering robust gains. This positive momentum was fueled by a more optimistic investor outlook, following the RBI Governor's indication that further interest rate increases might not be necessary. A recovery in South Korean stocks and other favorable international market trends also contributed to the buoyant trading session.

articles.title: Bitcoin falls to $62,600 as investors trim risk exposure after AI stock selloff; technical indicators signal caution

articles.title: Korea's AI crackdown may trigger healthy correction, India could benefit: Rahul Chadha
articles.content: South Korean regulatory actions are prompting a reassessment of AI semiconductor valuations, though experts see this as a healthy correction rather than an end to the rally.  Concerns linger over leveraged ETFs, with market watchers focusing on major tech firms' AI capital expenditure.  While India shows near-term strength due to easing geopolitical tensions and oil prices, job creation remains a medium-term focus. Foreign investors are rebalancing portfolios, not exiting India.

articles.title: India's textile industry poised for long-term growth as global sourcing shift gathers pace: Siddhartha Khemka
articles.content: India's textile sector is poised for significant growth, driven by a global shift in sourcing away from China and a cyclical recovery in demand. Experts highlight that geopolitical risks and rising costs are pushing brands to diversify, creating a multi-year opportunity for India. Proposed free trade agreements with the UK and EU are expected to further boost competitiveness, making Indian exporters more attractive.

articles.title: Vedanta may have a couple more tranches of promoter-driven selling; stock likely to bounce back in 1-2 weeks: Ambareesh Baliga
articles.content: Vedanta shares saw a significant drop following a large block deal, but analysts suggest the selloff is temporary. Beyond Vedanta, market strategist Ambareesh Baliga also shared insights on defence, textiles, and the auto sector.

articles.title: US Stock Market: Barclays, Stifel lift S&P 500 year-end targets on stronger earnings outlook
articles.content: Major financial firms Barclays and Stifel have boosted their S&P 500 year-end targets to 7,800, signaling strong confidence in corporate profits and the U.S. stock market's resilience. This optimism, fueled by AI advancements and improved investor sentiment, suggests further upside potential. While inflation and interest rate concerns linger, strategists see earnings growth and capital spending driving future gains, with a potential broadening of market leadership beyond tech giants.

articles.title: Global Market: BOJ policymakers push for faster rate hikes as inflation risks mount
articles.content: The Bank of Japan is growing more concerned about persistent inflation, with some policymakers advocating faster interest rate hikes after raising the policy rate to 1%, the highest in 31 years. Officials cited rising cost pressures from a weak yen, high energy prices and strong AI-driven demand, with some members suggesting rates may need to move closer to a neutral level of around 2% through gradual but more frequent increases.
